text:
Maria (AE): Quick heads-up — Veridian onboarding update. Renewal in ~3 months, CS health score dropped 12% last week. Theyre seeing p95 chat latency ~420ms during peak and token costs are 2.4x our initial estimate. Looking for proactive perf recommendations (quant, model swap, routing) we can propose in the enablement call next Tue.

Caroline (CS): Ack. Theyre flagged a few customer tickets about slower responses on long-context queries and one report of degraded summary quality after a naïve quant test. Want to avoid regressions in quality.

Sam (ML): Suggested plan: 1) Run controlled q4_0 quantization on rw-13b-v1 for non-critical routes; 2) Introduce rw-7b-q4_0 as a low-cost fallback for bulk batch jobs; 3) Add smart routing by user_tier and request_length. Quick config sketch below.

Sam (ML): ```
routing:
  - name: low_cost_fallback
    match: user_tier == "free" or request_length > 1024
    model: rw-7b-q4_0
    quantize: q4_0
    cache_policy: prefix_cache_enabled

  - name: default
    match: true
    model: rw-13b-v1
    quantize: q4_0
    autoscale: {min:1, max:6}
```

Sam (ML): For quality guardrails: run eval set of 500 prompts (mix of summaries, instructions, and retrieval-augmented queries). Track Rouge/ROUGE-like metrics, hallucination rate, and token delta. Canary at 10% traffic, evaluate, then 50%.

Alex (Eng): Implementation notes: we can add a rollout policy in Console: canary=10% for 24h -> metrics check -> 50% -> full. Need tracing hooks enabled (request_id mapping + per-token latency). Also put an automatic fallback to rw-13b-v1-unquantized if quality alert triggers.

Alex (Eng): Canary config snippet: ```
rollout:
  - phase: canary
    percent: 10
    duration_hours: 24
  - phase: ramp
    percent: 50
    duration_hours: 12
  - phase: full
    percent: 100
    duration_hours: 0
quality_alerts:
  hallucination_rate: 0.05
  latency_p95_increase: 0.15
```

Caroline (CS): Good. Ill prepare the customer-facing note: expected cost reduction estimates (rough): q4_0 + rw-7b fallback = ~35-45% TCO drop for chat-heavy traffic, p95 expected to go down for many requests but may increase slightly for very long context windows. Ill include the QA checklist and rollback steps.

Maria (AE): Please also include a short A/B plan I can present during the renewal conversation: delta in avg cost/token, expected latency changes, sample prompts where we saw quality parity.

Sam (ML): Will produce: 1) eval set + baseline metrics; 2) A/B plan with sample size calc; 3) small set of smoke tests for hallucination detection. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial artifacts.

Caroline (CS): Ill coordinate a 30-min enablement call with Veridian next Tue 11am PT. Action items: Sam -> eval + A/B plan; Alex -> rollout and tracing playbook; Caroline -> customer note + billing alert threshold; Maria -> schedule & renewal framing.

Redwood-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/rollout/veridian-quant-canary (initiated by Alex). ETA: 2024-11-05 15:20:00 UTC.

Maria (AE): Thanks team — this looks good. Ill capture feedback during the call and follow up with a short report for the renewal playbook.
